question.value: Constrain CN formation pathways through its vertical distribution and physical conditions in the Flying Saucer disk.

referee_caveats_inferred: The reported CASA 4.2.2 and TCLEAN combination needs clarification before reconstructing the imaging environment.
Table 2 uses 180 au for its outer tabulated radius, while the accompanying prose says 200 au.
Quoted flux uncertainties do not clearly reconcile with a roughly 10% flux-scale contribution.
The missing HF-ratio table prevents reconstruction of its numerical opacity test from the supplied text.
Characteristic heights depend on opacity, beam deconvolution and projected line-of-sight structure.
Table 4 midplane densities of 50.0 and 74.0 ×10^6 cm^-3 exceed the prose description of a few ×10^6 cm^-3.
Temperature-density degeneracy and absent fit uncertainties limit the precision of the physical-condition answer keys.
X-ray-driven formation remains an interpretation without a detected stellar X-ray source.
